ontario.description: Chartwell Collegiate Heights is a quiet and peaceful retirement residence perched on a scenic hilltop in the heart of Sault Ste. Marie. Once home to the city’s well-loved Collegiate high school, our residence blends history with serenity, offering panoramic views of the waterfront and lush greenspace. We're proud of our reputation for providing a secure, affordable, and close-knit community where residents and staff feel like extended family. In addition to our natural surroundings, we offer convenient access to nearby walkable amenities like grocery stores, banks, pharmacies, restaurants, shopping, and the cinema. Our residents love our neighbourhood for these reasons, plus our proximity to family.

ontario.name: Chartwell Anne Hathaway
ontario.tagline: Experience the active, culturally rich retirement you deserve in the Stratford community you know and love.
ontario.description: Chartwell Anne Hathaway is an established independent living retirement residence nestled in beautiful Stratford. Blending timeless charm with a distinctive architectural design, our intimate home is where heritage meets small-town living. Step inside our striking entranceway and be welcomed by long-standing, caring staff who make every day feel personal. Our inviting amenities reflect our unique character—like our charming dining room with a walk-out patio overlooking a walking path that winds around the residence. Deeply rooted in the Stratford community, many of our residents are from the area or have close family nearby, creating a warm, familiar atmosphere where meaningful connections flourish.

ontario.name: Chartwell Southwind
ontario.tagline: Retire in Sudbury’s desirable south end with the vibrant lifestyle you deserve.
ontario.description: Chartwell Southwind Retirement Residence is a hidden gem tucked away in one of Sudbury’s most scenic and peaceful neighbourhoods. Located just off the main road and surrounded by mature forest near picturesque Lake Nepahwin, our community offers independent seniors the perfect blend of nature, tranquility, and convenience. Here, you’re close to everything—shopping, restaurants, healthcare services, beaches, and boardwalks—yet tucked away in a serene, private setting that feels worlds apart. With engaging lifestyle options and supportive services tailored to your needs, Chartwell Southwind is where peace of mind and purposeful living come together.

ontario.name: Chartwell Westmount on William
ontario.tagline: Welcome to Sudbury’s nature-inspired retirement community, designed for your comfort, connection, and peace of mind.
ontario.description: Nestled in Greater Sudbury’s sought-after New Sudbury neighbourhood, Chartwell Westmount on William is an intimate, established residence set in a tranquil, park-like landscape surrounded by charming homes and frequent sightings of local wildlife. Our retirement home offers not only scenic beauty, but also a strong local reputation, an accessible bungalow-style layout, and a warm, close-knit atmosphere where residents and staff feel like family.

ontario.name: Chartwell St. Clair Beach
ontario.address: 13500 Riverside Drive East, Tecumseh, ON N8N 0C3
ontario.tagline: Where lakeside luxury meets personalized service in a retirement lifestyle defined by beauty, comfort, and connection.
ontario.description: Chartwell St. Clair Beach is an upscale, lakefront retirement community welcoming active and independent seniors in Tecumseh. Surrounded by quaint homes and lush green spaces, our retirement home is nearby many convenient amenities like grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, pharmacies, places of worship, and Beach Grove Golf and Country Club. Such a desirable location means you can benefit from all the shopping and services you need to lead the active and independent lifestyle you desire, yet still feel like you're living in a serene, tucked-away setting.

ontario.name: Chartwell Thornhill
ontario.tagline: A warm, heimish retirement community in the heart of Thornhill’s Jewish neighbourhood.
ontario.description: Chartwell Thornhill Retirement Residence provides seniors a warm and welcoming atmosphere in the heart of a thriving Jewish community. Offering independent living to our predominantly Jewish residents, our seniors’ home honours and celebrates Jewish cultural and religious values, including weekly rabbi lectures and services, as well as Shabbat services, holiday observances, and traditional celebrations that bring people together. Residents can also enjoy personalized care, gourmet dining options, and engaging cultural programs that celebrate Jewish traditions. Beyond that, we offer a vibrant lifestyle with diverse recreational activities, family-inclusive events, and a strong sense of connection—all within walking distance of local shops, restaurants, and synagogues.

ontario.name: Chartwell Glacier Ridge
ontario.address: 1261 Jasper Drive, Thunder Bay, ON P7B 6Z4
ontario.tagline: A friendly, welcoming place to call home in Thunder Bay
ontario.description: Located in the heart of Thunder Bay, Chartwell Glacier Ridge is a warm, independent living retirement residence that offers the best of both worlds: a peaceful, nature-connected setting paired with exceptional walkability to shops, restaurants, healthcare facilities, and other local conveniences. Here, you’ll enjoy the unique balance of quiet comfort and urban accessibility, all within a friendly and supportive community.

ontario.name: Chartwell Hilldale
ontario.address: 309 Hilldale Road, Thunder Bay, ON P7G 0A2
ontario.tagline: Experience a welcoming, scenic retirement lifestyle rooted in Finnish culture and connection in Thunder Bay.
ontario.description: Chartwell Hilldale is an independent living retirement residence located in Thunder Bay’s Port Arthur district. Nestled in a peaceful country setting surrounded by birch trees, our residence boasts stunning views of the Sleeping Giant and Mount Baldy—an inspiring natural backdrop to everyday life. Though serene and tucked away, we’re also conveniently close to city essentials. Minutes away you'll find big box stores, shopping centres, cozy cafés, and many places of worship, blending rural charm with urban convenience.

ontario.name: Chartwell Isabella
ontario.address: 1350 Isabella Street East, Thunder Bay, ON P7E 0A5
ontario.tagline: Enjoy the supportive lifestyle you desire, rooted in history, community, and connection in the historic setting of Fort William area in Thunder Bay.
ontario.description: Chartwell Isabella is an independent living retirement residence located on a quiet, tree-lined street dotted with well-kept century homes in the central Vickers Park neighbourhood. Located on the cherished grounds of a former schoolhouse, our residence reflects the enduring charm and community spirit of historic Fort William. Every outing—whether a stroll to local shops, lunch with friends, or a leisurely walk through the neighbourhood—offers a comforting sense of familiarity and connection to the past.

ontario.name: Chartwell Thunder Bay
ontario.address: 770 Arundel Street, Thunder Bay, ON P7A 8C8
ontario.tagline: Experience flexible retirement living surrounded by forest, wildlife, and scenic beauty in Thunder Bay.
ontario.description: Chartwell Thunder Bay is a grand retirement residence located in the desirable Port Arthur area, offering an independent living lifestyle and seniors’ townhomes for those who appreciate the peacefulness and inspiration of nature. Nestled beside a protected conservation area and enveloped by pristine Boreal Forest, our retirement community is just steps from the tranquil shores of Boulevard Lake and connected to walking paths that lead to nearby Centennial Park.

ontario.name: Chartwell Lansing
ontario.tagline: Experience flexible & supportive senior living in the heart of North York.
ontario.description: Chartwell Lansing is a warm, close-knit retirement residence tucked into a quiet residential street in the bustling Yonge-Sheppard neighbourhood of Willowdale. Known for our welcoming atmosphere and personalized care, our residence offers the comfort of independent senior living in a setting that feels like home. Here, you’ll enjoy peace of mind with flexible services tailored to your evolving needs—all while being just a block from Yonge Street and steps away from shopping, restaurants, cinemas, pharmacies, banks, healthcare facilities, and places of worship. Enjoy a short walk to the North York Library, attend a concert at the Toronto Centre for the Arts, or visit the farmers’ market at Mel Lastman Square—you’ll always have something to enjoy right outside your door.

ontario.name: Chartwell Avondale
ontario.address: 1238 Queen Street East, Toronto, ON M4L 1C3
ontario.tagline: Live vibrantly and stay connected in the heart of cultural, walkable Leslieville.
ontario.description: Located in the heart of artsy, eclectic Leslieville in Toronto’s east end, Chartwell Avondale has proudly served the community for over 20 years. Our retirement residence is nestled above a retail complex with professional services like a dental clinic, banks, and a beloved local bakery. Just steps outside your door, Queen Street offers easy access to independent shops, diverse restaurants, art galleries, live music venues, and cafés, while nearby Ashbridges Bay and Woodbine Beach provide scenic spots for relaxation. From community festivals to colourful street murals, the neighbourhood reflects the area’s creative, inclusive spirit and invites exploration at every turn.

ontario.name: Chartwell Grenadier
ontario.address: 2100 Bloor Street West, Toronto, ON M6S 1M7
ontario.tagline: Experience a vibrant and supportive lifestyle in Toronto’s desirable High Park neighbourhood.
ontario.description: Chartwell Grenadier is a dynamic retirement residence offering the perfect blend of urban energy and natural serenity in Toronto’s sought-after High Park area. Overlooking one of the city's most iconic green spaces, our independent living and assisted living retirement community is ideal for seniors who want to enjoy a safe, enriching lifestyle that reflects their personal interests, values, and independence.

ontario.name: The Sumach by Chartwell
ontario.tagline: Experience the freedom of condo-style living, the flexibility of à la carte services, and the culture of Toronto’s East End.
ontario.description: Stylish. Flexible. Unapologetically urban—The Sumach by Chartwell is a modern 12-storey residence offering rental apartments that feel more like boutique condos—with full kitchens, in-suite laundry, and access to elevated amenities. Located in one of Toronto’s most eclectic neighbourhoods, it’s ideal for those who want to live independently, with the option to add what you need, when you want it. Think of it as chic city living without the ownership hassle. From casual dining opportunities and housekeeping to wellness services that support your independence and vitality, it’s à la carte and on your terms. And with 24/7 on-site staff and emergency response, peace of mind is built in effortlessly.

ontario.name: Chartwell Valley Vista
ontario.address: 600 Valley Vista Drive, Vaughan, ON L6A 4H2
ontario.tagline: Rooted in Italian tradition, designed for vibrant retirement living in the heart of Vaughan.
ontario.description: Chartwell Valley Vista is a welcoming independent living retirement residence nestled in a quiet, upscale neighbourhood in Vaughan. Deeply rooted in Italian family values, our residence is known for its close-knit community feel, where warmth, connection, and tradition flourish. Offering flexible care options and a wide range of valuable services, our vibrant seniors’ community is especially cherished by residents of Italian heritage seeking a lifestyle that feels both familiar and enriching.

ontario.name: Chartwell Orchards
ontario.tagline: Enjoy a charming retirement lifestyle with personalized support that evolves with you, right in the heart of Niagara wine country.
ontario.description: Chartwell Orchards is a reputable continuum of care retirement residence nestled in scenic Vineland, where small-town charm meets modern comfort. Set among lush orchards and now featuring beautiful new renovations, our welcoming community offers more than just a place to live—it’s a place to thrive. Here, you can enjoy peace of mind knowing support is available as your needs evolve, with independent living, assisted living, and memory care all under one roof. It’s retirement living designed to grow with you.

ontario.name: Chartwell Clair Hills
ontario.address: 530 Columbia Street West, Waterloo, ON N2T 0B1
ontario.tagline: Experience upscale, worry-free retirement living in Waterloo, thanks to flexible services personalized to your lifestyle.
ontario.description: Chartwell Clair Hills is an upscale continuum of care retirement residence in the Laurelwood neighbourhood of Waterloo offering independent living and assisted living services in a refined setting that reflects all the comforts of home. Our established retirement community is known for its vibrant and energetic atmosphere, where you can comfortably age in place as your needs change over time. Here, elegant surroundings meet personalized service—so you can live confidently, comfortably, and completely on your own terms.

ontario.name: Chartwell Terrace on the Square
ontario.address: 100 Caroline Street South, Waterloo, ON N2L 1X5
ontario.tagline: Choose trusted retirement living in the heart of Uptown Waterloo.
ontario.description: Chartwell Terrace on the Square is an independent living retirement residence in Uptown Waterloo, known for its trusted reputation and welcoming atmosphere. Our conveniently located retirement community provides a comforting atmosphere where you’ll feel at home, thanks to bright, easy-to-navigate spaces and warm, tenured staff who know you by name. Just look at our famous great room, which overlooks beautiful views of our greenspaces and gardens!

ontario.name: Chartwell Oak Park Terrace
ontario.address: 1750 N Service Rd, Windsor, ON N8W 1Y3
ontario.tagline: Experience relaxed, single-level retirement living with cultural warmth in the heart of peaceful Windsor.
ontario.description: Chartwell Oak Park Terrace is a charming, bungalow-style retirement residence centered on active and independent senior living. We welcome you to explore the convenience of our accessible single-level layout, where you’ll find both our cozy one- and two-bedroom suites and bright, open-concept amenities. In addition to a warm and lively social atmosphere, retiring with us means you’ll have the comfort of an all-inclusive style of living and the peace of mind of personalized care services delivered by dedicated, long-standing staff.

ontario.name: Chartwell Oxford Gardens
ontario.tagline: Welcome to vibrant, resort-style retirement living in a friendly and supportive community in Woodstock.
ontario.description: Chartwell Oxford Gardens is a well-established independent living retirement residence with a trusted local reputation in the heart of Woodstock. Known for our vibrant and social atmosphere, we invite you to discover a lifestyle that blends independence with flexible support in a warm, welcoming setting. Choose from bright and spacious studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites—many featuring private balconies or walk-out patios designed for your comfort and enjoyment. We are well known for our strong community outreach and partnerships with senior centres in the area.
